name: publish_task_files
description: Show selected task files in the conversation. Use this when the user asks to see a computer/browser screenshot, a rendered page, chart, or other output. Inspection images are otherwise private working material, not chat attachments. Uses actual file IDs from tool receipts or list_task_files; never invent a file path or claim an image was sent without this publication receipt. Existing bytes and source versions are preserved.

name: list_task_files
description: List the actual files currently available to this task on the computer, with stable IDs and versions. Use after uploading a Library file or recovering an interrupted transfer.

name: read_task_output
description: Read a bounded exact excerpt of a completed tool receipt in this computer task. Useful after working context was compacted. Does not rerun the operation.

name: run_python
description: Execute Python on the connected computer against selected task files. Includes NumPy, pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, openpyxl, XlsxWriter, python-docx, python-pptx, ReportLab and PDF tools. Read files from assistant.files or /inputs; write artifacts to /outputs. Use assistant.publish(value) for a concise result and assistant.save_state(value) for reusable intermediate data. Isolated from network and general host files. Default 60 seconds and 2 GiB; request up to 1800 seconds, 8 GiB and 8 CPU cores when warranted. Use reviewed run_computer_command for installed GPU programs or host resources.

input_json.description: Optional JSON text parsed into assistant.input, or null. Use file IDs for datasets.

name: inspect_document
description: Open a task document, inspect page/sheet structure and render the requested actual page. Supports PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Formulas and cached values are separate; previews report coverage. Returns image evidence for the selected page and preserves the original.
